# Biome tests we consciously skip.
# These are intentional language differences, not bugs.
#
# Format:
#   # comment explaining why tests below are skipped
#   test-name-1
#   test-name-2
#
#   another-test # inline comment also works

# legacy type assertions: <T>expr (not supported)
ok/ts_type_assertion.ts
ok/ts_type_assertion_expression.ts
ok/type_assertion_primary_expression.ts

# decorators are more permissive than TS in Destack
error/decorator_async_function_export_default_declaration_clause.ts
error/decorator_class_declaration.js
error/decorator_class_declaration_top_level.js
error/decorator_export.js
error/decorator_export_class_clause.js
error/decorator_export_default_expression_clause.ts
error/decorator_function_export_default_declaration_clause.ts
error/decorator_interface_export_default_declaration_clause.ts
error/ts_decorator_object.ts
error/ts_decorator_on_class_method.ts
error/ts_decorator_on_class_setter.ts
error/ts_decorator_on_function_declaration.ts
error/ts_decorator_this_parameter.ts
error/ts_decorator_this_parameter_option.ts
error/ts_formal_parameter_decorator.ts
error/ts_formal_parameter_decorator_option.ts
error/ts_static_initialization_block_member_with_decorators.ts

# proposal syntax: import defer/source
ok/import_defer.js
ok/import_source.js

# Biome metavariables are not part of JS/TS syntax
ok/metavar.tsx

# empty type parameter lists are invalid in TS
ok/ts_type_parameters.ts

# legacy <T> type assertions are not supported
ok/ts_as_assignment.ts

# export specifiers do not allow string literal names
ok/export_named_clause.js
ok/export_named_from_clause.js
